STEP 2. Check turn-signal light state operation.
Q: Does any turn-signal lights flash?
YES (only one side illuminates) : Go to Step 3.
NO (no lights flash at all) : Go to Step 5.
STEP 3. Check ETACS-ECU connector C-114 and junction 
block connectors C-104, C-107 and C-109 for damage.
Q: Are ETACS-ECU connector C-114 and junction block 
connectors C-104, C-107 and C-109 in good condition?
YES : Go to Step 4.
NO : Repair or replace them. Refer to GROUP 00E, 
Harness Connector Inspection P.00E-2. The turn-
signal lights should flash normally.
